appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeHint: Switch between the original look and new designs. More themes can be added later.
appearance.autoHint: Aurora follows your OS light/dark preference.
appearance.particlesHint: Animated constellation behind the interface. Turns off automatically for reduced motion.
appearance.densityHint: Comfortable gives more breathing room; compact fits more on screen.

language.title: Language
language.displayNameHint: Shown instead of “You” in chats and issue reports.

theme.classicDarkDesc: The original Deep Space Glassmorphism look.
theme.auroraDarkDesc: Signature spectrum with a living constellation.

chatDefaults.title: Chat defaults
chatDefaults.hint: Starting values for new conversations. You can still change them per-chat.
chatDefaults.systemPresetPlaceholder: Optional instructions applied to every new chat…
chatDefaults.notificationsHint: Ask to notify you when a long generation finishes in the background.
chatDefaults.testNotifBody: If you see this, notifications are allowed.
chatDefaults.testNotifBlocked: Notifications are blocked — allow them in your browser settings.

server.title: Server
server.readHint: Read from the running server. These cannot be changed from here.
server.healthVersionNote: The navbar dot uses /health which currently reports a stale number; this page shows the accurate one.
server.applyHint: This server reads its config from environment variables / CLI flags at start-up — there is no live write API yet. Edit the values below to generate a command to run next time.
server.restartNote: Run this before starting the server next time. It does not change the running server.
server.p4Note: Detailed per-key config (with env/default/cli source) arrives with GET /v1/config in a later phase — shown as n/a until then.

data.title: Data
data.clearHistoryHint: Removes all saved conversations from this browser only. The server is untouched.
data.clearConfirmBody: This deletes every saved conversation in this browser. It cannot be undone.
data.exportHint: Downloads your preferences (theme, language, chat defaults, display name) as JSON.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.debugContextHint: The privacy-safe snapshot attached to issue reports.

about.title: About
about.tagline: Run models bigger than your RAM — weights streamed from NVMe on demand.
